question: What universal benefit arises when Śiva is situated in the Īśa direction?
premises: Śiva is situated in the Īśa direction.
The deity's placement has ritual efficacy.
The result extends to all beings.
inference: Śiva, situated in the Īśa direction, brings auspicious good to all beings.
plain_english: Śiva, situated in the Īśa direction, should bring auspicious good to all beings.
